newsitem.title: UK: Safeway up on NatWest upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Safeway up on NatWest upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc inched higher amid a generally weaker market as brokerage NatWest Markets upgraded the stock to "add" from "hold," dealers said.
By 1108 GMT, the shares were up 4-1/2p to 357-1/2.
The analyst wasn't immediately available to comment, but dealers said brokerage had a price target for the stock at 390p.
The last time the shares traded at that level was in early February.
Dealers said the brokerage was looking for a rebound in the shares after the UK supermarket chain reports its annual results on May 14. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
